design: Retest all 7x9x4 flat pairs, tiles and parities. For each held-out tile estimate a single illumination ratio from the opposite checkerboard tile stratum using a matched-duration dark offset inferred per tile and parity from the prior report. Normalize pair difference by sqrt(1+ratio^2). Then test removal of a plane fitted only on complementary 2x2 blocks within the tile; score raw, scaled, and scaled+detrended on the same blocks, pooled via two alternating folds and reported descriptively. Reproduce the previous all-block uncorrected ratios. This diagnoses a specific common-mode model and does not establish the physical cause of residual covariance, gain or dose linearity.
